t3_5_1.text: The party has crossed the Jehopa Ocean to Hianxo in response to a letter from Jiansho Academy for a tournament group entry, but the letter says little about who asked for them.
A woman with three white tails waits at the foot of the gangplank in Hianxo, bowing to the party with a smile.
The woman waiting at the gangplank is Honami Nemaden of Jiansho Academy, a three-tailed kitsune who personally petitioned the Academy to bring in fresh Guild talent for the tournament.
Honami says the Academy has provided the party passage and a place to stay, and that they need only accept her assistance to reach the grounds.
Honami claims she singled out Max specifically, calling him 'Darling' and saying he caught her eye.
Honami describes Megumi as 'the Black Palm,' remarkably dedicated to her craft, with a brutality in her technique that some find impressive.
Honami says she prefers a more refined approach than Megumi and claims Megumi lacks subtlety.
Honami says the tournament register is managed by a senior administrator in the main hall.
Honami says many would consider Megumi the favourite to win, but calls that a matter of opinion rather than fact.
A grey-haired steward by the main hall door is Lord Karos, present for his own reasons.
The grey-haired steward by the door is Lord Karos, present at the Academy for his own reasons.
Megumi Xianxu is Head of the Student Council at Jiansho Academy.
Honami says she finds the odds more interesting when they are uncertain, and suggests a new group entry could provide an upset.
The administrator said the party's entry papers were expedited.
Honami did not know Lord Karos had any interest in the tournament, and finds his presence peculiar.
The party's entry papers were expedited by the administrator at Honami Nemaden's name.
Megumi Xianxu is the Head of the Student Council of Jiansho Academy.
The party's first bout is against the Mountain Silence of the Guao, and the party has stepped onto the sand to fight it.
The senior administrator at Jiansho Academy confirms Honami Nemaden's group entry papers were expedited.
The silver-haired man watching from the door is Lord Karos, present at the Academy for his own reasons.

The grey-haired steward at the door is Hanzo Hattaxi, not a steward.
Hanzo Hattaxi confirms his name to Max but deflects what he is, saying it depends on who is asking.
